spec.scene: A weathered wooden wharf deck bathed in bright coastal afternoon sun. At the center, two round sourdough bread bowls of clam chowder sit on a rustic picnic bench. Leaning over the sturdy wooden railing are two figures in windbreakers, peering down at two plump brown sea lions perched on timber beams below. On the left, two colorful cruiser bikes rest against the rail. The sun casts sharp, warm shadows across the splintered gray planks.
spec.title: Chowder on the Wharf
spec.caption: Ate hot chowder on the pier while the sea lions yelled.
